Package backend.classes.reports

Class ZReportSummary

java.lang.Object
backend.classes.reports.ZReportSummary
public class ZReportSummary extends Object
Represents a summarized Z-Report for a business day.

Each ZReportSummary stores aggregated sales and transaction details, including totals for orders, payments, discounts, voids, and service charges. It also records employee signatures and payment breakdowns by type.
